pr.title: fix(release): verify final branch reference identity
pr.body:
Production release validation could skip the final live-source check when using executed qualification, and the shared branch guard compared only the extracted SHA. Validate the complete branch reference and require the late check in the protected release context while preserving offline local qualification and exact recorded CI run/attempt checks.

The five-file change preserves the newer final prepare hook, source-CI delegation, package qualification, publisher and prerelease controls. CI-proof test doubles remain mode-specific; a private omission mutation is refused.

Validation: 79 source-CI cases, 28 live-reference cases, four real wrapper scenarios, full pure publisher checks, 68 selected Python cases, legacy/v2 workflow assertions, a resource-free Release build with no warnings or errors, and the three controlled Aspire equality cases passed. The earlier 71-case artifact check is retained separately. Hosted source CI and genuine publication remain separate gates.

<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
---

> [!NOTE]
> **High Risk**
> Changes release publication gates and live source/CI binding; misconfigured workflow env or stricter ref checks could block or alter legitimate releases.
> 
> **Overview**
> Closes a gap where **executed** source qualification could skip the final live GitHub check outside a real release job, while tightening what counts as the current branch tip.
> 
> **`Assert-CurrentReleaseSource`** now treats `GITHUB_JOB=release` as mandatory for the late `verify-g4-release-source.sh` call even when validation mode is **executed**; local/offline runs still short-circuit as before. In release, it also requires a fixed **protected context** (repo, `main`/`prerelease`, `workflow_dispatch`, matching `build-release.yml` ref/SHA, numeric run id/attempt). **`EXPECTED_CI_RUN_*`** is passed through only for **ci** mode; legacy executed releases clear those env vars so the shell guard still checks live tip + push CI without pinning a recorded run.
> 
> **`verify-g4-release-source.sh`** no longer trusts a lone SHA from the ref API—it validates the full ref payload (`ref`, canonical `url`, commit `object` type/SHA/urls) before selecting successful push CI.
> 
> Tests and publisher doubles were updated: expanded ref-mutation cases in **`test-g4-release-source.sh`**, release-context scenarios in **`test-g4-source-ci.ps1`**, and expectations that protected executed publication always invokes the live guard once (plus a refusal path when the guard fails).
>
